# M1 closure qualification evidence — 2026-10-09

These sanitized records concern isolated fixtures on the hardware in `hardware.json`. No live M0 installation was changed. Private initialization responses, authentication cookies, database files and provider request bodies are excluded.

- `deterministic-results.json` identifies the clean 1,736-test Release result, project counts and the five readiness/twenty deployment checks after it. `final-tests.log` is an intermediate failure caused by SQLite EXISTS query-plan wording; `final-tests2.log` is the clean final run. Both are retained. Builds had zero warnings/errors.
- `compose-workflow.log` records the full deployed workflow. `compose-workflow-rsync-poll.log` adds actual rsync polling; both post-publication latency and total time including sync startup are reported. The earlier PDF-page failure is retained separately; its parser-to-publication regression now passes.
- `distinct-uid.log` covers daemon UID1654/sync UID1656 symlink and hardlink races, sticky claim substitution, and incoming-parent/inbox replacement.
- `extractor-isolation.log` is the current-image hardened rootless Podman qualification. Failed host-listener CPU probes and diagnostics are retained. The final probe inspects a real supervisor-spawned parser after initialization without weakening SELinux or sandbox permissions.
- `live-provider.json`, `live-throughput.json` and `live-provider-requests.jsonl` cover real local Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B/1024d capture, provider-free structured query, and four-worker ingestion of 100 Markdown/20 PDFs. Provider elapsed sums and tokens are separate from harness wall time. This is same-host GPU topology, not the specified separate private-LAN provider.
- `operator-handoff.md` is the concrete unrun privileged systemd step using the fresh self-contained merged publish; `operator-publish-sha256.json` hashes its files. Actual unattended sudo requires operator authentication. Static validation/container passes do not establish this gate.

`closure-final-deterministic-results.json` and `closure-final-{restore,build,tests}.log` identify the final 1,749-test source freeze after the retrieval, dirty-refresh, move and bounded-consolidation corrections.

`fullscale-final-genuine-rebuild.json` / `fullscale-daemon-results.json` record the actual 1,556.694-second rebuild, immediate successful query, exhaustive equivalence and zero provider calls. Their latency fields describe **pre-maintenance** 185.25/406.33 ms misses. `fullscale-final-post-consolidation-profile.json` records the subsequent final warm 45.279/313.792 ms pass and all 96 fingerprints; `fullscale-final-post-consolidation-startup-memory.json` records startup/vector-load, heap and daemon-plus-sandbox peak measurements. `fullscale-final-stage-summary.json` links the original artifact hashes. First-attempt latency/refresh failures and offline equality remain separate records. Reproduction commands and fixture/environment requirements are in the convergence report and tracked qualification harnesses. Earlier failed attempts are retained separately from final passes.

`live-publication-throughput.json` and `live-publication-provider.json` record supplemental actual ingestion/query overlap: Markdown 51 samples/19 validated overlaps/4 locators; PDF 54 samples/16 overlaps/9 locators. Search/query metadata, revisions and chunk text/context/pages resolve consistently while the same extraction jobs remain running across the measured queries. This does not claim observation of the exact SQLite commit instant; deterministic publication-fence/crash tests establish atomicity. The initial failed observer and diagnostic stderr remain preserved: requesting the oldest 200 jobs hid later PDF jobs; the final observer filters running jobs and brackets only the measured queries. Shared fixture admission slots respect the four-search budget, including structured queries (a static post-run correction). Quiet live throughput remains the acceptance baseline.

`artifact-manifest.json` hashes this sanitized evidence directory (excluding itself). `operator-publish-provenance.json` records the fresh 416-file merged self-contained bundle, unchanged lockfiles, frozen runtime-source correspondence, and independent host/Docker SDK provenance. The systemd command is ready but remains unrun.

For repository whitespace checks, durable text logs normalize trailing line whitespace; original raw qualification artifacts remain preserved under `/tmp/m1-closure` and `artifacts/m1-qualification`. A final formatting-only cleanup removed spaces on blank lines in `M1Schema.cs`; SQL behavior is unchanged, and runtime/bundle qualification predates that cleanup.
